title: Plausible false positive rejected by evidence gate
description: A reviewer claims a map read races, but the surrounding method holds an RWMutex.

candidates.title: Map read is allegedly unsynchronized

evidence.execution_path: Get reads values while another goroutine may write
evidence.violated_invariant: Concurrent map reads and writes require synchronization
evidence.falsifier_checked: Checked the return expression for an inline lock

candidates.impact: The alleged race could crash the process.
candidates.recommendation: Add a read lock around the map access.

verdicts.reason: The method acquires RLock before the cited read and defers RUnlock; the candidate ignored controlling context.
